observations: Sony's music team describes a unique adaptive system as the score's backbone.
The implementation addresses more than forty hours of open-world gameplay and exploration music.

inferences: Long exploration requires musical state and transition logic that can avoid obvious loops and binary combat switching.

limits: The session overview establishes scope but not all technical details.
